enriched.title: Verbos Irregulares e Comparativos em Inglês
enriched.summary: A aula aborda verbos irregulares, adjetivos muito usados, comparativos e superlativos, além de expressões úteis para o cotidiano. Inclui exemplos práticos e frases no contexto real.
mainTopics: Expressões úteis para o dia a dia

vocabulary.definition: To go down below the surface of a liquid.
examples: The boat is going to sink because there is a hole in the bottom and a lot of water is getting in.
The ship sank after hitting the iceberg.

vocabulary.definition: Feeling unwell or suffering from illness.
examples: Oliver and I are going to play tennis on the weekend if his knee is already well.
She stayed home because she was sick.

vocabulary.definition: An opening or hollow place in a surface.
examples: The boat is going to sink because there is a hole in the bottom and a lot of water is getting in.
There was a hole in my shirt.

vocabulary.definition: To use something completely so that no more is left.
examples: Lucy and Chris are going to run out of gas because there is very little gas in the tank and the nearest gas station is very far away.
I ran out of sugar while baking the cake.
Ahead light is crucial for driving at night.

vocabulary.definition: Comparative form of 'old', used to compare age.
examples: She is older than her brother.

vocabulary.definition: Superlative form of 'old', indicating the highest age.
examples: He is the oldest in the family.

vocabulary.definition: Comparative form of 'tall', used to compare height.
Superlative form of 'tall', indicating the highest height.
examples: He is the tallest in the class.

grammar.explanation: Verbos que não seguem o padrão regular de conjugação no passado e no particípio.
rules: Memorize as formas base, passado e particípio.
Use o verbo adequado ao contexto.
examples: sink – sank – sunk: The boat is going to sink.
hear – heard – heard: I’ve heard that you received a job offer.
commonMistakes: Confundir o passado com o particípio.
Esquecer de aplicar a forma correta ao contexto.

grammar.explanation: Usados para comparar ou expressar superioridade.
rules: Adicione '-er' para comparativos de adjetivos curtos (e.g., taller).
Adicione 'the -est' para superlativos de adjetivos curtos (e.g., the tallest).
examples: He is the oldest in the family.

expressions.usage: Usado para indicar que alguém está apressado.

practiceQuestions.question: Fill in the blank: Lucy and Chris are going to _____ of gas.
practiceQuestions.explanation: A expressão 'run out of' significa 'ficar sem', usada para indicar a falta de algo.

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: O barco vai afundar porque tem um buraco no fundo.
practiceQuestions.answer: The boat is going to sink because there is a hole in the bottom.

culturalNotes: Muitos verbos irregulares são usados no inglês cotidiano e são essenciais para a comunicação.
Expressões como 'in a hurry' são comuns em situações informais.
studyTips: Pratique os verbos irregulares com flashcards.
Compare objetos ou pessoas ao usar adjetivos comparativos e superlativos.
Leia frases contextualizadas para entender o uso correto dos verbos.
originalExamples: The boat is going to sink because there is a hole in the bottom and a lot of water is getting in. (O barco vai afundar porque tem um buraco no fundo e muita água está entrando.)

Lucy and Chris are going to run out of gas because there is very little gas in the tank and the nearest gas station is very far away. (Lucy e Chris vão ficar sem gasolina porque tem muito pouca gasolina no tanque e o posto de gasolina mais próximo fica muito longe.)
Oliver and I are going to play tennis on the weekend if his knee is already well. (Oliver e eu vamos jogar tênis no final de semana se o joelho dele já estiver bem.)
I’ve heard that you received a job offer but you aren’t going to accept it. (Ouvi dizer que você recebeu uma proposta de trabalho mas não vai aceitá-la.)
My grandmother is going to bring that delicious dessert that only she knows how to make. (Minha avó vai trazer aquela sobremesa deliciosa que só ela sabe fazer.)

warnings: practiceQuestions tem apenas 2 item(ns), recomendado mínimo de 3
